rulings.restated: Enter the amount from ftc helper "Credit is the smaller of creditable foreign tax and regular income tax; zero if no foreign tax".
rulings.model: The form line says only "Foreign tax credit. Attach Form 1116 if required", and the line 1 instructions are not in the pages given. Nothing given supports the rule that the credit is the smaller of creditable foreign tax and Form 1040 line 16, or the $300/$600 limit and conditions behind the Form 1116 refusal.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; project retained. The helper is the election to claim the credit without Form 1116 (i1116 pp. 1–2, the election to claim the foreign tax credit without filing Form 1116: the credit is the smaller of the total foreign tax and the regular tax when all foreign income is passive, reported on payee statements and within the $300/$600 limit); every failed condition refuses through `ftc.needs1116`. The ftc worksheet has its own render log. No change to the data.

rulings.restated: Add person.credit over every confirmed person entry, within the current person when parent-bound. An unanswered roster is unknown.
rulings.model: The restatement sums helper person.credit, which is not defined in the glossary, so it cannot be checked against the instruction to credit "the amount withheld in excess of $10,918.20", with no claim "if any one employer withheld more than $10,918.20". The married-filer refusal does properly exclude "Figure this amount separately for you and your spouse".
rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; project retained. `person.credit` is the per-person credit of i1040gi p. 117: zero unless more than one employer and total social security wages over $176,100, otherwise the withholding above $10,918.20, refused when any one employer withheld more than the limit (Form 843). The person worksheet has its own render log. No change to the data.
